leo2_improved.name: Leopard 2 Improved
leo2_improved.authority: Main ruled on 2026-10-29 (DECISIONS.md, ~11:00) that the release-264 2A4-era Leopards, rebuilt on the release Leopard 2 hull with the 2A4 turret derived from our 2A6 X (owner 2026-10-28: "update and cleanup our old designs ... and have them be the before variants basically") and unregistered from their later-variant 3D oracles on 2026-10-28 (Main: "where a rebuild's registered oracle shows a different (later) variant, unregister it"), qualify the geometry stage by this per-id photographic packet plus a shaded blind photo-critic PASS (lane evidence ~/cot-lanes/leo2a4-family-264-evidence, critic rounds on the SwiftShader Gallery stills). Numerical 3D comparison remains unverified. The Leopard 2 Improved is KMW's KWS II trial series (the KVT test bed of 1989, the TVM min and max of 1990; TVM max trialled in Sweden in 1992-94, leading to the Strv 122 and the 2A5), which ran with the L/44; TVM max later became the 2A6EX "Demo I" with the L/55 (tanks-encyclopedia). The fleet's Improved carries the L/44 with the L/44's round figures (the owner via Main, 2026-10-29; its old build drew the L/55 and fired the L/55 figures of the 2A7V spec it was copied from). The 2A6-look wedge front (owner 2026-10-28).
leo2_improved.envelopeBasis: Width is as built, 3.66 m over its own deep skirts; the TVM is published at 3.78 m including the track guards and 3.54 m without (tanks-encyclopedia). Length is as built: the L/44 gun forward from the stern plate (9.70 m, the 2A4's published 9.67 m, which the fixture holds) plus the hull's stern rack (0.36 m); the TVM is published at 9.97 m with the turret at 12 o'clock on its longer KVT-pattern hull (tanks-encyclopedia), which this build on the release hull does not reproduce. Tallest is the tip of its long whip antenna as built (4.99 m); the TVM is published at 2.48 m to the turret roof and 3.03 m to the commander's sight.
